answer: An agent economy running tasks like meadow hydrology or violet fluorescence imaging of sable habitats can deter Sybil attacks via hardware TEE attestation. Each agent generates an identity key inside an isolated enclave and submits a vendor-signed quote linking it to a unique fused chip ID, so verifiers reject duplicate hardware. Attackers must buy dedicated TEE processors per fake identity rather than renting VMs, though side-channel attacks can still extract root keys to forge clones.
